subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the bracketed word in the following sentence to fill in the blank.

The Government is planning to irrigate the ________ desert land by using water from the nearby river. (parched)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (1)** i.e. **'arid'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In this context the given sentence implies that the government wants to irrigate the dry area.
 
• **Parched : (शुष्क) **- Dried out, especially by heat; very thirsty.
 
 
• **Example:** After hours under the scorching sun, her throat felt parched and in need of a refreshing drink.
 
 
 
• **Arid : (व्याप) **- Having little or no rain; extremely dry; lacking in interest or vitality.
 
 
• **Example: **The arid desert landscape stretched for miles without a drop of water.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is 'arid'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rustic : (ग्रामीण) **- Characteristic of rural life; simple or plain; lacking sophistication.

 
 
• **Example:** They spent the weekend in a charming rustic cabin in the woods.
 
 
 
• **Lush : (उद्यानसार) **- Characterized by abundant vegetation; rich and vibrant.
 
 
• **Example: **The tropical rainforest is known for its lush and diverse ecosystem.
 
 
 
• **Only : (केवल)** - Without others; solely; exclusive.
 
 
• **Example: **She was the only person in the room who knew the secret.
